newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Yukong develops car filter.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Yukong develops car filter.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's leading oil refiner, said on Monday it has developed pollution filters that would cut down on automobile emissions.
In controlled tests, the filter has been shown to reduce automobile emissions by up to 95 percent and carbon monoxide by 80 percent, Yukong said in a statement.
Limited sales of the filter will begin later this year. Mass production will start sometime in 1998, when the company completes a plant with an annual production capacity of 150,000 filters.
The statement said Yukong invested 12 billion won over the past five years to develop the filter. ($1 = 825 won) -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
